decision: Can Pricing and 'How we're different' become one section, so the page shows price once?
primary_axis: where the tutor / learning centre comparison sits relative to the plan cards
where: Live prototype on the home page: /?variant=now|A|B|C|D|E (component src/components/price-compare-prototype.tsx, branch site/price-compare-prototype). Screenshots: <key>-1440.png (B, C, E only; D was changed after its screenshot).
invariants: headline 'Personal like a tutor. Structured like a learning centre. Priced like neither.' with eyebrow 'Pricing' and the guarantee line
the live Compare panel facts and descriptions (.design/research/competitors-2026-10.md); categories only, no competitor names (D-064)
section id 'price', so nav and /#price links keep working

options.cost: Price shown twice in two sections

options.bet: Ruled rows: tutor, centre, us, under the cards, same columns
options.benefit: Quiet; the price column reads top to bottom; keeps every description
options.cost: Repeats CAD 59 already in the card
options.risk: Rows can look like a footnote

options.bet: Grey band: our claim on the left, tutor and centre in grey on the right
options.benefit: Closest to the live panels; one block, clear winner
options.risk: Still feels like a second pricing row

options.bet: Head to head: parent picks 'a private tutor' or 'a learning centre'; them against us on cost, how it is made, along the way
options.benefit: Answers the one alternative the parent is weighing
options.cost: One comparison hidden behind a toggle
options.risk: Most parents do not click the toggle

options.bet: Annotated headline: each clause of the headline carries its price and description; nothing under the cards
options.benefit: The headline is the comparison; shortest page
options.cost: Comparison sits above the cards, not under
options.risk: A large grey headline may read as disabled

options.bet: Check matrix: made for your child / a set path / cost; only our row has both checks
options.risk: A dash for tutors on 'set path' and centres on 'made for your child' is a stronger claim than the live copy; D-067 rejected a verdict grid once
